description: Change or inspect connected personal code projects from any channel: apply exact-block edits, run bounded build/test commands, or run a bounded Semgrep security scan of the project folder. Every edit, run and scan needs approval unless explicitly whitelisted, and arrives as Approve/Deny buttons on messaging channels. Limited to registered working clones; credential files, VCS/generated directories, symlinks and destructive commands are refused. Reads use jarvis_code_read. Use jarvis_projects to discover project ids first.
